rationale: The clean-surplus reconstruction (ΔCEQ − retained earnings + Δdebt) is essentially the published Richardson–Sloan net external financing measure, but here it is deployed as a deliberate measurement/coverage test that holds the interaction structure fixed, and with coverage stuck at 0.079 across the entire family this is the single most informative diagnostic on offer — the main risk is that ΔCEQ absorbs OCI and acquisition currency, blurring the kink point.

This is a mechanical SUMRANK ensemble of two signals already in the archive whose components are analytically nested (the "surprise" is the level minus its own moving average, so the two are strongly correlated by construction), adding no new economic content and amounting to the cosmetic combination the objective explicitly discourages.

Putting the bounded dependence ratio inside the asymmetric structure is a defensible scaling change with a real outlier-control argument, but oancf now appears in both the flow denominator and the quality weight, so the two legs double-count cash generation and any improvement will be hard to attribute; magnitude compression also risks killing the alpha that came from asset-scaled dollar size.

This is a pure lookback-horizon parameter sweep on the incumbent kink with no new economic mechanism; the 1-year-versus-5-year gap is informative to know, but interpolating one knob setting is low-value knob-turning rather than a substantively different improvement.

The expression correctly implements the stated hypothesis (the indicator fires exactly when oancf<0 and roughly doubles the short-leg weight there) and a discrete-state non-linearity in the weight is a genuine departure from the family's smooth ranks, though the incremental effect is likely small since negative-OCF firms already sit near the top of RANK(NEG(oancf/at)), and the isolated short leg risks simply reloading on the distress/profitability tail that RMW already spans.

The diagnosis is sharp and correct — industry-demeaning the flow shifts the zero threshold that defines the kink, contaminating the gen-3 result — so isolating the peer adjustment to the credibility weight alone is a well-identified decomposition with a sound economic rationale rather than a cosmetic re-specification.
